$comment: Bash write-pattern data shared across all five runtimes. Pattern A runtimes (Claude bash, OpenCode JS, Pi TS) read this file at execution. Pattern B runtimes (Codex, Gemini) get this content injected as prose by scripts/sync.sh.
$dangerous_comment: Bash patterns that produce a write. Each entry names the construct + how the destination path is located. Variable / command-substitution destinations ($VAR, $(...), backticks) fail closed — guard cannot statically resolve them.

dangerous_patterns.name: sed-in-place
dangerous_patterns.destination: every non-flag positional argument after the script
